messages:
alice.m: OK team — change window scheduled for 2026-04-12 18:00 UTC. Operational freeze at 17:45 UTC. Target rollout: release/3.4.1 pinned to model v2.7. Please confirm pins, canary %, rollback criteria.
ben.platform: Confirmed pin: model:v2.7 and image sha:sha256:abc123. Proposed canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Timing: 20m at 5% then ramp if healthy.
deploy-bot: [deploy] queued: release/3.4.1 -> model:v2.7; canary=5%; scheduled start=1958765432
sara.qa: I'll run smoke + perf test suite once canary hits 5%. Smoke checklist: auth, simple-gen, embed lookup. Perf targets: p95 < 120ms, error rate < 0.5%.
mike.oncall: Alerting/rollback thresholds: if error rate > 1% for 5m OR p95 > 250ms for 5m -> auto-rollback to model:v2.6 + page the oncall rotation. Also manual rollback allowed.
ben.platform: Manual rollback commands for quick reference:
```
# kubectl rollback option
kubectl set image deploy/inference inference=redwood/inference:3.3.8 --namespace=prod
# deploy-bot rollback
/deploy rollback release/3.4.1 --to-tag release/3.3.8
```
alice.m: Unfreeze rules: normal freeze remains until +2h after 100% completion. Emergency-unfreeze allowed for critical security fixes or urgent infra migrations — tag PR with 'unfreeze-exempt' and ping #incidents + the release manager.
sara.qa: I'll run evals on the 'smoke-launch-2026' promptset and post diffs here (latency, hallucination rate, top-k variance).
deploy-bot: canary start acknowledged. canary=5% -> started at 1958765435.
deploy-bot: canary metrics (5%): p95=110ms, errors=0.2% after 7m.
ben.platform: sounds good — ramping to 25% now. Expected convergence ~10m.
deploy-bot: canary ramp to 25% complete at 1958765452. health check: p95=115ms, errors=0.23%.
alice.m: Hold 15m observation for regressions. If none, proceed to 100%. I'm green unless objections.
mike.oncall: watching dashboards and logs. Will escalate if thresholds hit.
sara.qa: 15m smoke cycle complete at 1958765470. No regressions, perf within targets. Posting short summary to the thread.
deploy-bot: rollout to 100% initiated. progress: 100% complete at 1958765487. New default model active: v2.7.
ben.platform: Pin recorded in Console: release/3.4.1 -> model:v2.7; ramp policy and commit sha logged under the release.
alice.m: Post-release actions: update release notes (include perf diffs and rollback triggers), tag images, and schedule a 24h watch. No postmortem needed unless incidents occur.
mike.oncall: Reminder: if rollback is triggered (manual or auto), run 'post-rollback-checklist' from runbook and notify customers if SLOs impacted.
alice.m: Thanks everyone :tada:
ben.platform: :shipit:
sara.qa: :thumbsup:
